a.xlink:title: The DT_DMS_Architecture class connects all classes of the DT-DMS framework.
The DT_DMS class is the general class of the Digital Twin Data-Models-Services (DT-DMS) framework.
Class representing a source of data collected from the ToI, i.e., a part of D in DT = ⟨D,...
Subject of the data observer pattern: an object that produces data and manages its observers.
Represents a descriptive model (m ∈ M_desc) of the Digital Twin.
Abstract base class representing a generic DT model m ∈ M of DT = ⟨D, M, S, μ⟩.
Represents a predictive model (m ∈ M_pred) of the Digital Twin.
Represents a prescriptive model (m ∈ M_presc) of the Digital Twin.
Abstract base class representing the class of automata 𝒜 of the DT-DMS framework.
Abstract base class representing a generic DT service s ∈ S of DT = ⟨D, M, S, μ⟩.
Observer of the data observer pattern: an object that wants to be told when new data arrives.
Class representing a Monitoring Service (s ∈ S_moni) of the Digital Twin.
Class representing a Prediction Service (s ∈ S_pred) of the Digital Twin.
Class representing a Diagnosis Service (s ∈ S_diag) of the Digital Twin.
Class representing an Optimization Service (s ∈ S_opti) of the Digital Twin.
Class representing a Control Service (s ∈ S_cont) of the Digital Twin.
Class representing the model inference or data assimilation function μ : Ω_D × M → M of DT = ⟨D,...
How a mixed segment ω ∈ Ω_D^mix(t_now) is assimilated, depending on the DT requirements.
